items.title: Have you seen her? Limpopo police search for missing 15-year-old girl
items.summary: A desperate search is under way for 15-year-old Tanya Maphosa, who has not returned home since leaving her Palmietfontein residence on Monday afternoon without telling anyone where she was going.

items.title: Bail proceedings postponed after fatal attack on man, 25, at Jeffreys Bay hangout
items.summary: Three of the four accused admitted punching Daniël Stevens, 25, in affidavits read in the Humansdorp Regional Court on Friday. All four denied acting together or planning to kill him.

items.title: Child, two-month-old girl die in Geldenhuis shack fire
items.summary: A devastating shack fire in Geldenhuis has claimed the lives of a child and a two-month-old girl, whose charred remains were found inside the collapsed structure after firefighters extinguished the blaze.

items.title: Norse Atlantic airline files for bankruptcy
items.summary: Norwegian low-cost carrier Norse Atlantic, hit by surging jet fuel prices, has filed for bankruptcy just hours after its aircraft leasing contracts were terminated.

items.title: ‘A Walk in the Night’ to remember enslaved people in Cape Town
items.summary: Cape Town’s annual ‘A Walk in the Night’ will begin at 10pm on November 30, tracing sites linked to slavery before concluding at the Slave Tree at midnight on Emancipation Day.

items.title: Community rallies to assist Westville dog attack victim, Sizwe Doncabe
items.summary: Cellucity Pavilion branch manager Jarred van Reenen has offered Sizwe Doncabe a Samsung A27 cellphone, a Vodacom SIM card and 12 months of monthly data following the brutal Westville pit bull attack.

items.title: Ekurhuleni council supports motion to establish deputy mayor position
items.summary: Ekurhuleni councillors have backed a proposal to create the metro’s first deputy mayor position, subject to approval by the Gauteng MEC for Co-operative Governance and Traditional Affairs.

items.title: DA’s ‘arrogance’ cost it chance to govern eThekwini, insiders claim
items.summary: DA insiders said the party’s approach to coalition talks may have cost it a role in governing eThekwini, after the ANC and MK Party agreed to lead the metro.

items.title: Conflict and El Nino deepen hunger crisis across Africa and beyond
items.summary: The United Nations has warned that acute hunger could worsen across 16 global hotspots between December 2026 and May 2027, with Sudan, South Sudan, Somalia, northern Nigeria and Yemen facing the greatest concern.

items.title: When promises become political currency, accountability must be the price
items.summary: Parliament must ensure that commitments made by the executive are not reduced to political rhetoric but translated into tangible improvements in the lives of South Africans.

items.summary: The DA’s last-ditch attempt to form a coalition with the ANC in eThekwini failed, leading to the MK party taking its first metro and setting its sights on leading the province.

items.summary: Fikile Mbalula has criticised former president Thabo Mbeki for publicly calling on ANC leaders to take responsibility for the party’s electoral decline.
